decision_question: Can three independently worded candidates per answerable target yield 100 complete source-linked clusters while duplicate candidates are recorded as quality failures and deterministic policy templates own boundary questions?

method.method_change: Generate three candidates for each answerable target, deterministically reject duplicate candidates, and select the first independently recoverable wording; deterministic templates own all boundary probes.
author_receives: canonical answer and exact spans for answerable construction cases
method.boundary_authority: Versioned deterministic policy templates for abstain, clarify, and refuse cases; no model may mutate the expected action or empty evidence lineage.
method.deterministic_authority: Exact source-span recovery, action recovery, ambiguity, naturalness, leakage, duplicate candidates, selected-question uniqueness, source lineage, and quota checks are applied locally after every response is durable.
method.response_identity_policy: Require exact unique case/candidate ID sets and restore frozen request order locally.

prospective_rationale.attempt_004_result: Seven provider calls completed before a duplicate candidate list triggered a whole-run parser termination; no source, case, prompt, model, gold, quota, or acceptance gate caused the stop.
prospective_rationale.harness_only_correction: Duplicate candidates remain durable and are rejected as per-candidate quality failures instead of terminating execution.
